extensionDescription.message: Makes Firefox wear a mask to look like Microsoft Edge to websites that otherwise won't work.

breakageWarning.message: While Edge Mask may help if you see a "Browser unsupported" message, it could cause unexpected breakage on some sites.

reportBrokenSite.message: If you find a site which works better with Edge Mask enabled, please report it $IN_PRODUCT_REPORTER$ or $WEBCOMPAT$. Thank you! ♥

maskStatusOn.message: The mask is on! I pretend to be Microsoft Edge on this site.

maskStatusOff.message: The mask is off. I look like Firefox to this site.

maskStatusUnsupported.message: The mask cannot work on this site.

preferencesFallback.message: To adjust preferences, please open the Extension Manager, select Edge Mask, and hit Settings.

addSiteHostnameExplanation.message: Note: Always enter the full domain name. If you enter example.com, Edge Mask will not be active on www.example.com!

addSiteErrorAlreadyActive.message: Edge Mask is already enabled for this domain!

siteListEmpty.message: You did not enable Edge Mask on any site yet!

manageSitesClearConfirmation.message: Do you want to remove all masked sites?

shortcutsToggleMask.message: Toggle the mask for the current site
